title: Mirai_Botnet_Investigation_c74
description: Investigate and identify the source of unusual traffic patterns and performance degradation in the network.

levels.title: Introduction
levels.content: The network has experienced unusual traffic patterns and performance degradation. Your task is to investigate and identify the source of these issues.

levels.title: Get Access
levels.cloud_content:
You have SSH access to the bot1 host with the following credentials:
- Username: cyrano
- Password: cyrano
levels.local_content:
You have SSH access to the bot1 host with the following credentials:
- Username: cyrano
- Password: cyrano

levels.title: Identify Suspicious Service
levels.content:
Identify and investigate an unauthorized or suspicious service responsible for periodic external communication.

**Question:** What is the name of the suspicious service that is beaconing to an external host?
levels.solution: Check the systemd services and look for any unusual or recently created services. The suspicious service is likely named `bot-beacon.service`.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Check the systemd services and look for any unusual or recently created services.

levels.title: Determine Command-and-Control Server
levels.content:
Determine the external host communicating with the compromised system.

**Question:** What is the IP address of the command-and-control server that the suspicious service is communicating with?
levels.solution: Investigate the network connections and logs of the suspicious service identified in the previous task. The command-and-control server IP address is `192.168.70.5`.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Investigate the network connections and logs of the suspicious service identified in the previous task.

levels.title: Identify Abnormal Network Traffic Service
levels.content:
Identify the service responsible for generating abnormal volumes of network traffic.

**Question:** What is the name of the service that is generating the abnormal network traffic?
levels.solution: Look for services that are not part of the standard system configuration and check their logs for unusual activity. The service generating abnormal network traffic is likely named `bot-flood.service`.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Look for services that are not part of the standard system configuration and check their logs for unusual activity.
